note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera; the original is in English; entry no. 2 (genus Epicalotermes). The source pack continues with the genus-level description of genus 11, Procryptotermes, which was not used.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, with a pale V-shaped mark in front of the Y suture; anteclypeus pale brown; pronotum slightly paler than the head or as dark as it; coxae and femora white, tibiae and tarsi pale brown; wing membrane transparent, costa, subcosta, radius and radial sector sclerotised, media and cubitus pale brown, weakly sclerotised. Head sparsely pilose, with a few long and short hairs; anterior margin and central part of the labrum with a few hairs; margins and disc of the pronotum also with a few hairs; anterior margin of the wings with a few hairs. Sides of the head capsule parallel; head length to mandible base 0.94—1.17, maximum width 1.10—1.22 mm; semicircular behind the compound eyes. Y suture distinct. Compound eyes large, elliptical, long diameter 0.38—0.45. Ocelli elliptical, 0.14—0.17 long, 0.09—0.11 mm wide, almost touching the compound eyes. Antennae 15—16-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 or 4, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum much wider than long, anterior margin convex. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum as wide as the head or slightly wider; width 1.11—1.35, maximum length 0.70—0.79 mm; anterior margin weakly concave; sides slightly convex; posterior margin strongly concave. Wing membrane transparent, venation as in the genus. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; arolium absent.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, darker anteriorly; postclypeus, antennal ridges and labrum pale reddish brown; mandibular base reddish brown, apex nearly black; antennae yellowish brown, pale reddish brown at the base; pronotum pale reddish brown; legs yellowish brown to pale brown; abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head sparsely pilose, with long and short hairs; anterior margin and disc of the labrum with a few hairs; anterior half of the postmentum with a few setae and the whole surface with short hairs; margins and disc of the pronotum with a few hairs. Head capsule dorsoventrally flattened, longer than wide; head length to mandible base 1.94—2.44, width 1.61—1.93 mm; sides weakly convex, convergent anteriorly; posterior margin weakly concave; Y suture distinct; frons inclined anteriorly, concave in the middle. Compound eyes large, long diameter 0.20—0.28, short diameter 0.10—0.22 mm, elliptical to weakly triangular, pigmented. Antennae 12—13-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 3 long and strongly sclerotised. Labrum much wider than long, sides nearly parallel, anterior margin drawn out into a point. Mandibles stout, strongly curved, incurved from a basal hump towards the apex; basal hump well developed; length exceeding half the head length to the mandible base. Left mandible 1.44—1.77 mm long, with 2 well-developed and 3 weakly developed marginal teeth. Right mandible with 2 widely separated marginal teeth. Postmentum long, club-shaped; length 1.29—1.81 mm; widest anteriorly, maximum width 0.58—0.74 mm; narrowest slightly below the middle, minimum width 0.25—0.28 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, as wide as the head or slightly narrower (width 1.64—1.87, length 0.93—1.06 mm); anterior margin deeply and angularly concave, slightly raised; sides slightly wavy near the middle, weakly convergent posteriorly; posterior margin distinctly concave. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; arolium absent.
